name: trade-journal
description: Local trade journal for XAUUSD + US100 scalping

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,web,analytics -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "npm run dev:analytics"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.install:analytics: cd analytics && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix web test
